**Job Title:** Senior Quality Engineer
**Location:** UK Wide (Hybrid)
**Role Type:** Permanent
**Clearance:** Active SC (Security Cleared) or SC eligible
**Who we are**
We're the largest pure play Quality Engineering consultancy in the UK.
Over the past 6 years, we've redefined what quality and testing look like at 2i and to our clients. Born from a desire to view quality holistically across the entire SDLC, our Quality Engineers (QE's) are at the heart of delivering world-class consultancy services.
Proudly certified as a "Great Place to Work", 2i are the chosen employer of around 300 QE's and we're continuing our growth! We recently announced our eight-figure funding injection as we aim to increase our revenue by more than £50m in the coming years, that is where you come in...
**What we're looking for...**
We're looking for people who let curiosity lead them. We don't expect to have a team of "experts". What we do expect, is for #Team2i to be...
* Inquisitive
* Open to challenge and be challenged
* Taking initiative
* Accountable
You have experience with various types of software and infrastructure and are passionate about helping to improve the quality of products you work on, through questions, curiosity and exploration. Our projects and clients are diverse, so what we really look for are people driven to develop and expand their skillset and knowledge.
**About the role**
We're looking for an experienced **Senior Quality Engineer** to join one of our collaborative engineering teams, working on a large-scale, cloud-based platform with a core focus on data quality and automation.
This is an opportunity to work on a modern engineering project where automation is at the heart of delivery. You'll help assure the quality of complex data processing and services, designing and maintaining automated tests while working closely with developers, business analysts and fellow Quality Engineers throughout the software development lifecycle.
You'll be part of a supportive, experienced team that values continuous improvement, knowledge sharing and engineering best practice. Beyond project delivery, there will also be opportunities to contribute to innovation initiatives that improve tooling, processes and ways of working across both your immediate team and the wider engineering community.
**You'll need to be...**
* Deep commercial experience with automation, developing automated tests in **Python** using **PyTest**.
* Experienced with **BDD** frameworks such as **Cucumber/Gherkin**.
* Comfortable testing data-focused applications and using **SQL** to validate data and investigate issues.
* Understanding of Python data libraries such as **Pandas** and **NumPy**.
* Commercially experienced working with **Kubernetes** and containerised environments.
* Experienced integrating automated testing into **CI/CD** delivery pipelines.
* Confident using **Git** and version control as part of collaborative software development.
* Comfortable debugging automation failures and carrying out root cause analysis.
* Experienced working with structured data formats such as **CSV** and **JSON**.
* Able to collaborate effectively with developers, business analysts and cross-functional engineering teams to build high-quality test coverage from requirements.
* A collaborative communicator who thrives in Agile delivery environments.
* Passionate about coaching and mentoring others, supporting the growth of less experienced engineers and helping build a strong engineering culture.
* Adaptable, proactive and able to balance changing priorities while maintaining high quality standards.
**What we can offer you...**
* Leadership pathways tailored to your personal and professional development, providing clear direction for your career at 2i.
* 26 days annual leave, plus the option to buy or sell up to five additional days.
* Private Healthcare alongside a range of wellbeing benefits including gym memberships, counselling services and Cycle to Work schemes.
* Annual performance bonus of up to 10%, linked to both individual and company performance.
* Flexible hybrid and remote working across the UK.
* The opportunity to work alongside highly skilled Quality Engineers on modern cloud technologies while continuing to develop your technical and leadership capabilities.
We don't believe in the "perfect" hire. What we do believe in is building diverse teams with different perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. If you're passionate about Quality Engineering, eager to learn and excited by solving complex technical challenges, we'd encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement.

# Capital Project Manager (Consultant) – Brook Rural Museum
Job Title: Capital Project Manager (Consultant)
Salary: Fee: £23,250 + VAT (Development Phase) and £34,850 + VAT (Delivery Phase) inclusive of travel & disbursements
Terms: September 2026 – November 2027 (initial Development Phase)
Location: The Wye Rural Museum Trust, Brook Rural Museum, The Street, Brook, Near Ashford, Kent TN25 5PF
Closing date: 12:00 pm, 28 Aug 2026
Brook Rural Museum is entering a pivotal new chapter, having secured initial development funding of £218,000 from The National Lottery Heritage Fund for a project that will help safeguard the Museum’s future.
The Museum is now seeking an experienced Capital Project Manager to help shape and lead the project’s Development Phase from September 2026 until planned submission of a full grant application for £1,468,000 in November 2027. Reappointment for the Delivery Phase will be subject to the Museum securing the full grant from the Heritage Fund and required match funding, as well as satisfactory performance in the Development Phase.
Set in the small village of Brook, in the heart of the beautiful Kent Downs National Landscape, the Museum occupies a magnificent Grade I barn and Grade II oast house containing a collection of farming and rural implements, offering visitors vivid insights into rural life in the horse-drawn age.
Urgent work is needed to address issues of damp and pest control and safeguard both the historic buildings and the Museum’s collection. Alongside this conservation work, the project will improve accessibility, enhance interpretation, create sheltered outdoor space, and develop a food and beverage offering. Together, these improvements will provide a more welcoming environment, in which a wider range of visitors can connect with Kent’s rural heritage.

Job Title: Project Curator
Salary: £38,049
Hours: Full time
Terms: Fixed term up to 2 years with potential to extend subject to funding
Location: The Almonry, Evesham, Worcestershire
Closing date: 5:00 pm, 28 Aug 2026
An exciting opportunity has arisen to join The Almonry Museum for The National Lottery Heritage Fund ‘Re-Imagining the Almonry’ Development Phase as the **Curator**.
We are looking for an experienced curator to embark on an exciting project to completely re-interpret and re-display the stories of Evesham and the Almonry. The prioritising of collections to best support the new interpretation narratives at The Almonry Museum will be an important part of the job. The postholder will also contribute to wider project planning, evaluation and activity development, recruit and manage volunteers, and help secure additional funding to support project delivery, while contributing to the development and delivery of a Delivery Phase application to The National Lottery Heritage Fund.
If you are organised, flexible, passionate about collections and engaging people in the stories of the past, this job offers an excellent opportunity for you to create a re-imagined museum in this much loved historic building in the heart of the beautiful Vale of Evesham, Worcestershire. ## Description
We are looking for a Portfolio Steering and Cat Risk Analyst for our Marine team based in the London or New York City office.
The specific nature of Marine risks, including static and non-static exposures, requires management within a consistent global framework. Rapidly evolving exposures, risk mitigation approaches, tools, processes, and research demand continuous adaptation and up-to-date expertise. Detailed business monitoring and portfolio steering activities require sustained involvement and analytical focus. This role is vital to understanding exposure hotspots, market changes that affect a portfolio, and related trends/changes within the competitor landscape.
**Your Team**
Our team combines portfolio steering expertise with advanced catastrophe risk analytics to drive informed decision-making across our Marine line of business. We are responsible for strategic portfolio monitoring, natural catastrophe and terrorism portfolio modelling, accumulation management, data quality oversight, and reinsurance-related analytics. Using cutting-edge tools and industry-leading CAT modelling platforms, we collaborate closely with underwriters, actuaries, and reinsurance teams to ensure our Marine portfolio remains resilient, profitable, and well-positioned for growth.
**The Impact You Will Have**
In this role, you will play a pivotal part in protecting our global Marine portfolio from natural catastrophe risk. You will identify and quantify CAT accumulation exposures — both modelled and non-modelled — across all relevant Sub Lines, directly enabling smarter risk mitigation and stronger underwriting controls. Applying your catastrophe modelling expertise, you will drive team objectives forward and guide colleagues in best practice. You will collaborate closely with Product Leaders, the CUO Technical Office, and Regional Marine Underwriting teams to shape and enhance our CAT underwriting strategy. Through maintaining and developing underwriting tools — including risk visualisation, capacity steering, and individual risk assessment capabilities — you will ensure our teams can make confident, data-driven decisions within clear authority frameworks. Partnering with CAT Management and CFO Risk Management, you will ensure consistency with our overall accumulation strategy, accurate reporting of Marine values, and the appropriate reflection of risks in pricing and model development.
**Some of your specific responsibilities could include**:
* Develop CAT Underwriting tools and reports specific for our Marine line of business both to enable portfolio steering and to support the underwriting process.
* Run Catastrophe loss modelling reports and prepare regular and ad-hoc data extracts and reports including portfolio analyses, CAT limit monitoring, supporting global business steering and providing input to ensure adequate Reinsurance protection.
* Cooperate closely with the Product Leaders, Technical Office and Regional Underwriting specialists. Support the definition of the risk appetite and capacity steering.
* Serve as business owner for IT and data initiatives, leading end‐to‐end scoping, prioritisation, and delivery of reporting and transformation projects, ensuring solutions such as Power BI dashboards directly support Marine Underwriting and portfolio steering strategy while advancing the data platform landscape.
* Provide on the spot consultancy and translate or explain CAT Modeling results and reports to Marine underwriters.
* Evaluate and make recommendations to ensure Marine specific requirements and exposures are most appropriately reflected and cater for the special nature of Marine.
* Provide training and education of the Marine Underwriting community on CAT-related topics.
* Collaborate with Underwriting and other relevant functions (Actuarial, Risk Management, Reinsurance, Global Accumulation and CAT Risk Management, ARC, Claims, etc.) to support business steering, portfolio management and data quality improvements.
**What You’ll Bring to the Role**
* Experience in CAT risk management and catastrophe modelling.
* Experience in CAT analytics within a catastrophe modelling vendor, insurer, or reinsurer.
* Hands-on experience with CAT modelling tools.
* Excellent communication skills, strong attention to detail, and a collaborative team-oriented approach.
* Ideally cat management experience in Insurance or Reinsurance
* Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience in Excel, VBA, SQL, or similar.
* Project Management experience
* Degree preferably in Geosciences, Engineering or Mathematics
* Professional experience in insurance and/or reinsurance is preferred.
* A willingness to learn and explore how AI can enhance your role and the broader organization is expected.

## The allsaints team
At AllSaints we are in the business of feelings - making our customers feel cool and confident. If, like us, you believe in the power of a great outfit, we'd love to talk to you.
We're a global brand made up of a very diverse mix of talented people in a huge variety of roles. Our products are designed in house and made by a small number of suppliers and artisans around the world to sustainable standards.
We are a brand embarking on a very exciting plan and we are seeking new members of the team who want to contribute to this.
## The role
Our senior stylists are the fundamental link between our products and customers, delivering exceptional customer service based on great product knowledge, selling skills and styling, but also through being a role model to the rest of the stylist team.
As a senior stylist you will have the opportunity to take ownership of running a floor or department, opening and closing the store, and assisting the management team in merchandising to create an engaging shopping experience. You will also support handling first line customer enquiries via our online customer service system, with the remainder of your time being spent with in-store customers.
Our senior stylists will have spent at least a year in a stylist role with us already, mastering all aspects of the stylist role across product, proposition and people and demonstrating fantastic customer centric service every day. You will be consistently demonstrating the brand values and ambition to progress at AllSaints. This role will challenge you to the next stage in your career and encourage your development through a wider scope of remit and opportunities.
## What will I be doing?
* You will be responsible for the opening/closing of the store, demonstrating confidence with cash handling, keyholding and security, deploying the team according to your store’s floor plan and delivering team briefs
* You will manage the delivery of our products, ensuring that our deliveries are efficiently processed by the team and newness hits our floors as quickly as possible for our customers
* You’ll make sure all daily tasks and requests are dealt with accurately and quickly, adhering at all times to company policies and procedures actively collaborating and sharing our values with the stylists
* You will implement best practice and ways of working within the store, mentoring new joiners to the team and demonstrating the AllSaints way of working
* You will support the brand leader and store manager with any management responsibilities, ensuring that the back of house operations are completed and standards maintained
* Learn and understand how shift rotas are organised and deployed, acting as a point of contact for any general queries from stylists if they need support
* Lead the placement of our bestsellers and key investment merchandising to entice and attract our customers
* Identify selling opportunities by actively approaching all customers with the intention of building rapport, influence styling and closing the sale
* You will handle and respond to first line customer queries, emails, chats, and calls across multiple topics relating to product and customer orders via our online customer service system
* You will be empowered to make service decisions for our customers to resolve their issue whilst retaining their loyalty and trust
* You make use of all available training material to confidently display a thorough product knowledge so that you are able to sell the AllSaints brand to the customer and upskill the stylist team
* Ensure immaculate presentation of the store at all times in terms of cleanliness, organisation and merchandising of both the sales floor and back of house areas
* You will be confident in your ability to influence and coach team members in order for them to maximise their growth within the brand
* You will be able to create an environment where you inspire others and work as one team to deliver an exceptional brand experience consistent with our brand values
* You will be predominantly store based with between 30 and 50 percent of your time spent on online customer service delivered either within the store or from time to time on a work from home basis
* You will work in partnership with our specialist customer experience team leaders, receiving coaching on service delivery and ensuring that more complex customer queries are escalated to our specialist teams promptly
## What skills do I need?
* You will need to have spent a minimum of a year in a stylist role at AllSaints before progressing to the senior stylist role
* You will be seen as a role model, already delivering great and consistent performance at stylist level with the ambition to step up into line management in the medium team
* You live and breath the AllSaints values and behaviours and can confidently explain these expectations to other members of the team
* You are confident and capable in your role and have a great understanding of AllSaints’ processes and procedures
* Your team feed off your positive attitude and have a winning mentality to get the best results

## Description
UKGI CSMs are responsible for helping public sector organisations realise their business in the cloud. As leader of the UKGI CSMs, you will lead a team of Customer Solutions Managers responsible for guiding and supporting AWS customers along their multi-year cloud journey - accelerating migration delivery, driving modernisation, enabling GenAI adoption, and ensuring customers realise measurable business outcomes from their AWS investments. The UKGI CSM team supports customers from commitment to execution. CSMs support large-scale migrations, partner-attached delivery, and strategic account engagement - working backwards from customer objectives to accelerate long-term cloud adoption and realise revenue. The team operates at the intersection of sales, delivery and technical enablement, coordinating across account teams, partners, professional services, and service engineering to deliver outcomes for customers at scale. You will recruit, develop, and lead a team of technically capable CSMs across Europe who are obsessed with customer success. Working with your team and cross-functional partners across AWS, you will drive strategy, accelerate customers' cloud adoption, and define and then deliver against revenue realisation goals. You and your team are accountable for successfully delivering customer migrations, modernisation initiatives, and GenAI/Data outcomes. In this role, you will be technically credible in your own right - ready to dive deep into workload adoption patterns and customer architectures - while also effective in shaping the customer journey through others. You must enjoy learning and introducing new concepts to help colleagues and customers embrace and adopt new technology. You will coach your team on executive engagement, programme delivery, migration acceleration, and business case development. You will need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other parts of AWS, as well as representing your team at a senior level internally and externally. Supporting a broad portfolio of UKGI customers, you will establish mechanisms to inspect customer health and programme delivery at scale, optimise CSM coverage through data-driven resource allocation, and build sector-specific delivery frameworks that enable proactive intervention before issues impact revenue or customer outcomes. Key job responsibilities As a key member of the UKGI AI, Emerging Tech & Customer Acceleration team, you will: - Ensure success and growth in your customers' cloud and AI journeys. - Hire, onboard, train, and develop CSMs across Europe. Attract bar-raising talent with the technical depth and customer obsession the role requires. - Set and measure goals, coach and mentor employees, and contribute to the evolution of the global public sector CSM function. - Define metrics for team progress, build audit mechanisms to track performance and variance. - Be accountable for revenue acceleration, migration delivery, and team development goals. - Coach CSMs to lead matrixed teams, manage cadence, drive executive engagement, and help customers work backwards from business outcomes to executable delivery plans. - Implement systematic sector engagement through business reviews, escalation paths, and standardised delivery reporting. - Build relationships with senior customer decision makers to accelerate adoption. - Act as a conduit between customers, engineering, product and support teams. Influence product direction from aggregated customer feedback. - Build a team that delivers without you. Grow future leaders, and remove single-point dependencies. - Drive adoption of CSM best practices: GenAI/agentic AI enablement, migration acceleration, partner enablement, and customer value realisation. A day in the life Your morning starts reviewing migration delivery dashboards - checking which customers hit migrations kicked off this week, which are at risk, and where to redirect capacity. This is a senior, client-facing role combining technical leadership, project delivery, business development and strategic growth. * Experience developing or scaling new consulting propositions or service lines.

# Inference QA Engineer
Applied Computing was founded in 2024 to build Orbital, a physics-informed foundation model for energy operations. We’re live across oil and gas, refineries, and petrochemicals, working towards our mission: sustainable abundance for a growing planet.
The hydrocarbon industry keeps the world running. But its complexity has left operators tied to legacy systems, making critical decisions on less than 10% of available data. We built Orbital to change that. It’s a foundation model built specifically for energy that lets companies use AI at scale, harnessing all of their operational data and optimising in real time for any metric. Decisions get faster, operations get safer, and carbon intensity falls.
We’ve raised over $32 million, including one of the largest seed rounds for an AI company in the UK. We’re just getting started
**About the role**
We build Orbital, an agentic LLM platform that answers hard operational and analytical questions for enterprise clients in energy and heavy industry. It routes questions across a graph of tools (data retrieval, SQL-generating coders, statistical analysis, anomaly detection, forecasting, RAG) and synthesises answers that engineers act on. When it is right, it compresses hours of analyst work into seconds.
When it is subtly wrong, quiet, or slow, that costs us trust with technical customers who check our numbers.
We are hiring a senior engineer to own inference quality end to end: the person who watches every deployment, decides what “working” means, builds the systems that prove it, and catches regressions before a client does. This is a founding-level QA function. You will define the discipline, not just execute a checklist.
**What you’ll own**
Evaluation frameworks. We test on a tiered model: T1 data retrieval, T2 statistical analysis, T3 open-ended inference and root-cause, each with its own pass threshold. You will own and extend this framework, design test sets with real ground-truth rubrics (expected answer, pass criteria, known failure modes, source tables), and set the bar for what ships.
The test harness and its runs. We run prompts against live model endpoints at scale (tens of thousands of runs), on schedules and on demand, measuring consistency across repeated iter-ations, ground-truth match, structural correctness of generated queries, and paraphrase robust-ness. You will run these executions, keep the harness healthy, and turn raw runs into a verdict.
Model and agent monitoring systems. You will build the observability layer for a multi-step agentic system: not just “did the endpoint return 200” but did the planner route to the right tool,did the tool actually execute, did the agent loop terminate, and is the final answer grounded.
Concrete failure modes we already fight and want caught automatically:
• Silent empty responses — the reasoning trace renders but the answer stays empty, while every layer reports success.
• False refusals — a tool crashes or times out, returns nothing, and the model fabricates “I don’t have that data” instead of erroring loudly.
• Tool-routing misses — the planner should have fired a tool and didn’t, or double-counts raw identifiers instead of canonical ones.
• Latency and non-termination — multi-tool agent loops that blow past timeout budgets.
• Paraphrase and run-to-run instability — the same question three ways, or the same prompt three times, giving materially different answers.
Ground truth and the feedback loop. You will work with subject-matter experts to extract vetted ground truths from deployment feedback, feed them back into the eval sets, and close the loop so every confirmed defect becomes a permanent regression guard.
Regression discipline. After every fix ships, you devise tier-appropriate tests biased at the failure mode plus regression guards, run them against the deployment, and report pass-rate against threshold and whether the original failure recurred. You are the gate.
**What we’re looking for**
• 5+ years in software, ML, data, or QA engineering, with real ownership of a quality-critical system.
• Strong Python. Comfortable in a FastAPI + Postgres + Docker world, reading logs across services and tracing a request through a distributed pipeline.
• Fluency with LLM behaviour: prompting, tool/function calling, agentic loops, RAG, and the ways they fail (hallucination, refusal, silent truncation, non-determinism).
• Experience designing evaluation: LLM-as-judge, deterministic checks, ground-truth scoring, statistical consistency measures (e.g. coefficient of variation across repeated runs).
• SQL literacy — you can read a generated query and judge whether it answers the question and hits the right tables.
• A monitoring and observability instinct: you reach for dashboards, alerts, and trace inspection by default, and you build them when they don’t exist.
• Rigour about uncertainty. You report calibrated ranges, not overclaimed point estimates and you say plainly when something is unverified.
**Bonus**
• Experience evaluating or red-teaming agentic / multi-tool LLM systems specifically.
• MLflow or similar trace and experiment tooling.
• A background talking to technical end users (engineers, analysts) and translating their “it feels off” into a reproducible test.
• Time-series, forecasting, or industrial and operational data domains.
**Why it matters**
Our customers are engineers who verify our output. Inference quality is the product. This role decides whether we can look a client in the eye and say the system works, and back it with numbers. You will have the mandate to build that assurance layer from the ground up.

2. Collaborate with the Regional Lead Pharmacist to ensure the effective allocation of resources and staffing levels to meet service demands.
3. 14. Support with new site set up to ensure smooth onboarding from both a services and supplies perspective as well as pharmacy provision. Also, assistance will be necessary for the demobilisation process following site closures.
15. Support the Regional Leads in managing budgets and financial resources allocated to pharmacy services, ensuring cost-effective practices and optimal resource utilisation.

**Leadership :**
1. Set and maintain the highest standards of compliance and quality assurance within pharmacy services, supporting Lead Pharmacists in ensuring regulatory requirements are met.
2. Assist Lead Pharmacists with project work, policy review and updates, and competency frameworks, contributing to the development and implementation of quality assurance measures across pharmacy services.
3. Work collaboratively with other Senior Clinical Pharmacists to ensure continuity and consistency in service delivery and professional standards.
4. Provide direction and leadership to direct reports, setting clear objectives and priorities aligned with organisational goals.

# Senior Scientist – Peptide discovery, Biologics Engineering
**Location**
Cambridge, England, United Kingdom
**Job ID** R-257653 **Date posted** 03/08/2026
Apply
**Introduction to role:**
Are you ready to harness in vitro display platforms to unlock the next generation of peptide therapeutics for patients? In this Senior Scientist role, you will apply your expertise in mRNA, phage, yeast, and ribosome display to discover and optimize recombinant peptides that can reshape treatment options and accelerate our pipeline.
Based at our Discovery Centre in Cambridge (UK), you will join a multidisciplinary team operating at the interface of technology and biology. You will design and execute robust experiments, analyse complex data with modern tools, and translate insights into high-quality candidates and platform improvements. Can you see yourself building smarter libraries, running decisive selections, and using data and automation to make better decisions faster?
**Accountabilities:**
* Peptide Discovery Campaigns: Lead end-to-end selection campaigns using mRNA, phage, yeast, and ribosome display, delivering validated peptide hits with clear go/no-go criteria.
* Library Design and Engineering: Design and generate high-quality peptide and scaffold libraries that maximize diversity and fitness for purpose, aligned to target biology and downstream developability needs.
* Selection Strategy Innovation: Devise and execute enrichment strategies that improve specificity, affinity, and functional outcomes; iterate based on data to increase hit quality and rate.
* Next-Generation Sequencing Analytics: Apply NGS to quantify enrichment, decode sequence-function trends, and guide prioritization and optimization.
* AI- and Data-Driven Decisions: Use AI, machine learning, and computational methods for sequence prioritisation, library design, and lead optimisation to improve success rates and speed.
* Automation and Workflow Development: Implement and refine automated workflows to boost throughput, reproducibility, and efficiency across discovery activities.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with protein sciences, assay development, and therapeutic area teams to align discovery outputs with biological function and clinical relevance.
* Rigorous Experimentation and Documentation: Plan, execute, troubleshoot, and optimize experiments; maintain accurate, high-quality records and communicate results clearly to diverse stakeholders.
* Platform Advancement: Propose and implement new selection strategies, chemistries, and workflows that expand capability and impact of peptide discovery across the portfolio.
* Delivery and Impact: Translate scientific creativity into tangible pipeline assets and platform innovations that increase probability of technical success and shorten time to patient benefit.
**Essential Skills/Experience:**
Education & Experience Requirements:
* PhD in molecular biology, biochemistry, protein engineering, peptide science, or a related discipline, with relevant postdoctoral or industry experience; alternatively, a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree with substantial equivalent experience in peptide or biologics discovery.
Required Skills:
* Strong hands-on experience in molecular biology methods and technologies (e.g., PCR, RT-PCR, cloning (ligation-dependent and independent methods), site-directed mutagenesis, Sanger sequencing/analysis), ideally applied to generation of peptide (or other protein scaffold) libraries.
* Extensive experience of peptide hit identification and engineering using display technologies such as mRNA, phage, yeast, and ribosome display, including library design/generation, and selection campaigns using diverse enrichment strategies.
* Experience with next-generation sequencing (NGS) applied to peptide discovery.
* Experience applying AI, machine learning, and/or computational methods to therapeutic discovery, ideally in support of peptide hit finding, sequence prioritisation, library design, or lead optimisation.
* Experience with automation and/or workflow development to improve discovery efficiency, reproducibility, and throughput.
* Ability to optimize protocols, troubleshoot, interpret experimental results/data and maintain accurate, high quality and up-to-date experimental records.
* Demonstrated scientific creativity, with the ability to propose and implement new workflows, selection strategies, and platform improvements that enhance peptide discovery and engineering capabilities.
* Strong communication skills in a team environment and an ability to learn and embrace new technologies quickly.
**Desirable Skills/Experience:**
* Experience with incorporation of non-canonical amino acids in in vitro display systems and their application to peptide discovery or optimisation.
* Experience in therapeutic antibody discovery: hit identification and optimisation.
* Experience in high-throughput antibody screening, reformatting and characterisation methods including in vitro biochemical assays (ELISA, SPR, BLI or flow cytometry) and functional assays.
* Experience with leading/co-leading and/or managing research projects.

But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.

You will work with cutting-edge biotechnology, new drug modalities, and rich data to shape how serious diseases are treated, including opportunities at the earliest stages where impact is greatest. We value kindness alongside ambition, empowering you to take smart risks, collaborate deeply, and see your discoveries turn into medicines that reach patients.

## Job Title
Senior Portfolio Risk Analyst
## Department
Investment Risk, Analytics and Research-BG-UK
## Overview of Department
Investment Risk, Analytics & Research provides independent, investment-relevant insight, oversight and constructive challenge that strengthen portfolio decision-making, support accountability and reinforce confidence with clients, boards and the firm. The function operates as an independent second line of defence with a front-office mindset: it does not manage portfolios; it engages directly with investment teams and brings judgement, analytical rigour and challenge to the investment process, enabling investors to act with conviction and continuously improve.
The function's mandate and remit are purpose-based: any feature, factor or behaviour of a portfolio is in scope where independent oversight adds value. Concentration and clustering; factor and style exposures; valuation and growth expectations; scenario and stress behaviour; thematic exposures such as AI and climate; and behavioural patterns.
The function is lean by design and increasingly AI-enabled. Routine production, standard data provision and first-pass analysis are increasingly scaled through platforms, automation and AI-enabled workflows, releasing senior time for the work that creates distinctive value: second-order analysis, forward-looking research, judgment-led oversight, constructive challenge, strategy engagement and client-relevant articulation.
## Purpose of Role
Reporting to a senior member of Investment Risk, Analytics & Research, the Senior Portfolio Risk Analyst provides independent, experienced insight, oversight and constructive challenge on investment risk and portfolio construction, as part of a second line of defence with a front-office mindset. The role leads risk engagement with designated investment strategies, produces research and bespoke analysis that adds value to the investment process, contributes to and leads projects that advance the function's analytical tools and AI-enabled ways of working, and articulates risk credibly to investors, client-facing colleagues, clients, boards and governance forums, with the purpose of improving decision-making and outcomes for clients. This position has been deemed a Certified role within the FCA's Senior Manager and Certification Regime. As a result occupants details will be displayed on the FCA register and both initial and annual fitness and propriety assessments must be completed.
## Responsibilities
* Lead independent oversight, insight and constructive challenge for a designated group of investment strategies (including a preferred opportunity to oversee engagement with Emerging Markets and related strategies), engaging directly with investment teams on portfolio risk characteristics and portfolio construction, so that risks are intentional, understood, proportionate and aligned with strategy philosophy and client expectations.
* Produce and present risk reporting, deep-dive analyses and bespoke research that are insightful and decision-relevant, combining quantitative techniques with qualitative judgement and concluding with an explicit ‘so what’ rather than data-only reporting.
* Originate and lead research on portfolio construction, thematic and emerging risks, and market behaviour, directing work towards material topics and translating findings into engagement that lands with long-term, fundamental investors.
* Contribute to and lead projects that advance the function's analytical toolkit, automation and AI-enabled workflows, converting repeatable analysis into scalable, governed tools and raising the quality, consistency and reach of the function's output.
* Prepare and present material for investment risk discussions with investment strategies, product groups, committees, boards and governance forums; raise and track risk actions; and escalate unresolved concerns through the appropriate routes in a timely and evidenced way.
* Communicate investment risk to a broad range of stakeholders (investment teams, client-facing colleagues, clients, boards, and external academics and practitioners), including training, client meetings and occasional external presentations.
* Mentor and develop Analysts and Associate Analysts within coverage pods, strengthening the depth, resilience and talent density of the function.
* Where staff management responsibilities are delegated to the job holder, manage the relevant team members, including clear and appropriate apportionment of responsibilities and resources and management of staff, including training, development and appraisals.
**Your knowledge and experience**:
* A substantial track record in investment risk, investment or portfolio analysis, portfolio construction, quantitative research or a closely related investment discipline.
* Experience engaging with, influencing and constructively challenging senior investment decision-makers, with the credibility and independence of thought to hold a view under pressure and to leverage evidence-based insights.
* A record of combining quantitative insight with qualitative judgement to influence investment processes and outcomes.
* Fluency in modern approaches to working with data: strong Python and SQL (or close equivalents), comfort with large datasets.
* Practical experience using AI, including large language models and agentic or automated workflows.
* Experience originating and producing research that is influential with sophisticated audiences.
* Sound knowledge of financial mathematics, portfolio theory, company fundamentals and financial statements.
* Direct investment experience (for example, as an investment analyst or portfolio manager), supporting the translation of quantitative risk measures for long-term, fundamental, bottom-up investors (preferred).
* Knowledge of Emerging Markets, Asia-Pacific and China equity markets, including country, currency, liquidity, governance and benchmark dimensions (preferred).
* Experience with commercial factor risk models (for example, MSCI Barra or equivalent), scenario analysis and performance attribution (preferred).
* Experience designing, building or governing automated and AI-enabled analytical workflows in an investment context (preferred).
* Line management, mentoring or analyst development experience (preferred).

*Driving Continuous Improvement*

* *Cross-functional influence,* build relationships across clinical operations, regulatory, biostatistics, and beyond

* *Intellectual challenge*, work with cutting-edge data collection technologies and emerging industry trends that keep your skills sharp and future-proof

* Proven project management skills, with a PMP certification considered a bonus
* The ability to translate complex data into clear insights through metrics analysis and reporting
* Outstanding communication skills, whether you're presenting to senior leadership or collaborating with a vendor team, you know how to land the message

Our Design department is scaling its AI visual production capabilities - and we're looking for a Senior AI Creative Designer who will produce high-quality visual creatives with the primary goal of improving conversion rates. We’re looking for a designer who is deeply engaged with the fast-moving AI landscape, proactively tests new tools, features, and approaches, and is driven to continuously improve how AI is used in day-to-day creative work.This role sits at the intersection of creative storytelling, generative AI, and performance marketing - creating visual assets that capture attention and convert cold traffic across Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, Google, and landing pages: from static ads to lifestyle imagery and photorealistic human characters.
You will work closely with marketers, copywriters, media production, and video editors to produce assets that are photorealistic, visually compelling, and true to client product specifications.

AI Visual Production:
Create high-quality AI-generated visuals for performance marketing campaigns across paid media channels and landing pages.
Produce photorealistic human imagery, lifestyle scenes, and product-focused visuals.
Work with source materials from photo shoots - enhance, retouch, and extend imagery using AI tools.
Generate multiple creative variations to support testing and scaling across campaigns.
Ensure consistency with brand guidelines and product requirements across all assets.
Creative Iteration & Testing:
Iterate on visual concepts based on performance data and creative feedback.
Explore different visual angles, hooks, and formats to improve conversion rates.
Collaborate with copywriters and marketers to align visuals with messaging and funnel logic.
Translate briefs into multiple creative directions, not just single outputs.
Quality & Realism:
Ensure high visual quality and realism (lighting, composition, anatomy, textures).
Identify and fix common AI issues (artifacts, distortions, inconsistencies).
Maintain a strong visual standard across all generated content.
AI Tools & Workflow:
Use modern AI tools and models to generate, refine, and enhance visual assets.
Actively research, test, and integrate new AI tools to improve output quality.
Work within structured production workflows with a focus on execution and creative output.
Performance & Optimization:
Understand how visual content impacts campaign performance and audience engagement.
Adjust creative output based on data and testing results.
Support A/B testing by delivering multiple creative variants.
Collaboration:
Work closely with marketers, copywriters, media production, and video editors to ensure creative alignment.
Provide visual input during concept development and campaign planning.
Ensure assets are structured and ready for use in video production and marketing funnels.
Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards.

Strong visual sense: composition, lighting, color, typography, realism, and human anatomy.

Ability to iterate quickly based on feedback and data.

Proactive mindset - suggesting improvements, not just executing tasks.

Portfolio with AI-generated photorealistic visuals demonstrating quality and high-end visual sensibility.

Our goal as a company is to enable change that truly matters.
Against a backdrop of increasing geopolitical uncertainty, evolving cyber threats and heightened pressure on national security, the UK’s Defence landscape is undergoing its most significant transformation in recent history. The convergence of digital, physical and information-based threat demands the UK employ a proactive, and adaptive approach to cyber resilience and security assurance. To support, we are rapidly expandingour Defence portfolio, bringing together technical expertise and defence sector knowledge to help our clients address emerging risks, strengthen their security capabilities, and deliver robust and innovative solutions that protect critical defence capabilities, assets and operations.
We are seeking talented and motivated Cyber Security Consultants, across all grades, with experience working in Defence, to join our team and contribute towards this mission. We are looking for people who intuitively understand our defence clients’ needs, consider both immediate and strategic goals, and can apply their experience creatively to meet new and complex challenges.
As our clients develop and deploy increasingly sophisticated technologies, as a Cyber Security Consultant your role will go beyond delivering traditional risk assurance assessments. You will play a key role in helping our clients understand and respond to their increasingly complex threat landscape by shaping secure and resilient solutions for some of the UK’s “next generation” defence capabilities. You will combine technical expertise with strategic insight to address the cyber security implications of integrating emerging technologies within evolving operational concepts, ensuring that our client’s defence capabilities are resilient, secure-by-design, and capable of operating effectively, enabling the UK to maintain operational advantage in an increasingly contested environment.
**Key Responsibilities**
* **Cyber Security Advisory:** Provides cyber security advice and assurance across defence programmes, ensuring systems and capabilities are secure, resilient, and aligned with UK Defence and Government security requirements.

* **Risk Management:** Undertakes risk and maturity assessments and cyber assurance activities to provide strategic guidance on how to improve cybersecurity posture using a risk-based approach with articulation of mitigations/ controls and their respective impact on reducing risk.
* **Threat Modelling:** Assesses the impact of emerging threats and adversary capabilities on current and future defence systems, providing actionable recommendations to enhance system resilience.
* **Next Generation Technologies:** Supports the secure adoption of innovative technologies, including PNT solutions, autonomous systems, cloud-based services, and data-centric capabilities.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Builds strong relationships as a trusted partner, and ‘critical friend’ with key client stakeholders, demonstrating an innate understanding of our clients’ needs, challenges, and opportunities.
* **Communication:** Utilises strong written and verbal communication skills to support presentations, reports, and broader communications to a diverse set of audiences including senior stakeholders, including the translation of technical concepts into business language.
* **Delivery:** Accurately delivers high-quality work to agreed timelines, taking the initiative, utilising the strength of the wider team appropriately to support you, and knowing how to jump straight in.
* **Innovation:** Stays abreast of emerging technologies, defence trends, and evolving cyber threats to ensure Daintta, and our clients, can remain ahead of the ever-changing security landscape
* **Growth:** Helps to support & grow Daintta by actively contributing towards business development activities that support the growth of the Defence portfolio and wider company strategy helping to shape our future.
* **Our Values:** Representing us and our core values: transparency, fairness and daring.
**Skills/Knowledge**
* Strong background in defence or intelligence, either government or industry.
* Strong understanding of UK Defence, National Security & Government security requirements.
* Strong understanding of security challenges associated with emerging and next-generation defence capabilities.
* Demonstratable knowledge of contemporary cyber threats, state-based adversaries, and the evolving defence threat landscape.
* Understanding of resilience, survivability, and cyber security considerations within contested and degraded operational environments.
* Knowledge and/or experience of best practice cyber security industry frameworks and standards, such as NIST, CAF and ISO27001.
* Knowledge of defence security policies and frameworks such as Defence ones JSP 440 (Defence Manual of Security); JSP 604 (Defence Cyber Security Framework); UK Gov / MoD Secure by Design
* Familiarity with managing supply chain security through MOD DEFSTANS, ISNs and adherence to export controls.
* Industry experience undertaking strategic, cyber security projects.
* Industry experience supporting security assurance activities for complex, high-assurance or mission-critical systems.
* Experience / the ability to work in secure and classified environments.
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong interpersonal skills.
* Degree or qualification in cybersecurity, IT or a related area, or otherwise demonstrable experience in a related field.
* You demonstrate continued personal development through relevant certifications, academic qualifications, hobbies, and/or wider interests.

Hybrid, with 2-3 days working from Daintta office (London or Cheltenham) or on client site as required.

You will be joining the company at Daintta "Consultant" grade. In addition to being rewarded fairly for your contribution to the business, you get to work in a dynamic organisation that is agile and responsive. A business that is growing fast and where you get to drive and shape the future. A place where you are respected by everyone and your voice is important. Somewhere where you can be innovative and creative. A place where you have the opportunity to learn about all aspects of business from marketing to sales, to delivery and business operations.

# Safeguarding Case Management Group Independent Member
United Kingdom
## Job Description
*The Rugby Football Union (RFU) are seeking a Safeguarding Case Management Group Independent Member to join the The Safeguarding Case Management Group (SCMG) in volunteer capacity.*
**Volunteer Opportunity: Safeguarding Case Management Group Independent Member**
* **Role Type:** Volunteer appointment
* **Anticipated Commitment:** Approximately 8 hours per month, including meeting preparation and urgent case consultations
* **Location:** Primarily virtual (via Microsoft Teams), with occasional attendance at Allianz Stadium
* **Expenses:** Reasonable expenses reimbursed
* **Accountable to:** Chair of the Safeguarding Case Management Group
**Application information:**
* Please submit an anonymised CV (i.e. remove personal details) or an expression of interest.
* Vacancy closing date: **Friday 14th August 2026 17:00PM**
* Shortlisted applicants will be invited to participate in an interview via Microsoft Teams
**Nature and scope:**
Everyone involved in rugby is important and we take our responsibility for their welfare and wellbeing seriously. We want the rugby environment to be a safe and happy one.
The Safeguarding Case Management Group (SCMG) is a cross departmental group charged by the RFU with assessing the risk that individuals may pose to children and adults at risk.
The SCMG consider concerns or referrals presented by the RFU Safeguarding Team and decide on the appropriate outcome following any investigation, including those by police, social care or any other regulatory agency. Information is considered on a paper-based basis and decisions made using a risk-based approach and the balance of probabilities standard.
The SCMG also consider information disclosed on a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) certificate and assess whether the applicant is potentially suitable or is deemed a risk to children or adults at risk.
SCMG members are expected to balance the rights of individuals against the RFU's responsibility to safeguard children and adults at risk, ensuring decisions are fair, proportionate, evidence-based and focused on welfare and safety.
It is essential that the SCMG brings together a wide range of perspectives from both within our sport and outside of it.
We're looking to extend our current complement of expertise and invite applications from individuals who wish to volunteer to use their personal and professional skills, experience and judgement to ensure that Rugby Union in England is safe for children and adults at risk.
**We would be particularly interested to hear from those with a statutory safeguarding or Human Resources backgrounds, or those with experience of safeguarding in sport, including those who have skills in supporting victims of abuse and knowledge of trauma informed practice.**
**Accountabilities:**
* To act with integrity and independence to ensure the decision making process of the SCMG is fair and considered with the primary focus of the safeguarding of children or adults at risk.
* To have an understanding, or a willingness to understand, the RFU Safeguarding Policies, RFU Regulations and the statutory legislation underpinning safeguarding.
* Be guided by the principle that all children and adults at risk have the right to protection from abuse regardless of their age, ability, race, ethnic origin, gender, disability, social status, size, religion or sexual orientation.
* Understanding of safeguarding practice within diverse communities and ability to identify how culture, disability, protected characteristics, vulnerability and lived experience may influence risk and safeguarding outcomes.
* Have an awareness of and commitment to managing information in the strictest confidence.
* To declare any conflict of interest or connection with a particular case.
**Person Specification:**
**Essential:**
* The ability to make proportionate, reasoned and justifiable decisions in safeguarding cases, demonstrating confidence participating in multi-disciplinary decision making.
* Knowledge of safeguarding legislation, statutory guidance and best practice relating to children and adults at risk.
* Ability to access and analyse a variety of evidence in written and other forms
* A professional background in safeguarding or experience of safeguarding in sport
**Desired:**
* Knowledge of the sport of rugby
* Knowledge of human resources and disciplinary proceedings
**Additional Information:**
* This post holder must maintain an appropriate standard of confidentiality. Any disclosures of confidential information (including personal information kept on computer or other media) made unlawfully outside the proper course of duty will be treated as a serious disciplinary offence.
* Successful applicants will be expected to undertake induction and any safeguarding training identified by the RFU alongside maintenance of their safeguarding knowledge through ongoing development.
* The SCMG meet via Teams on a monthly basis. Meetings are generally held on the second Thursday of each month and take place between 10:00 and 12:30. In preparation for this meeting, packs are distributed one week prior to meetings with papers and reports that will require thorough reading.
* In addition, particularly when the Safeguarding Team are considering the need for an immediate suspension, SCMG members are asked to respond within 24 hours to requests for views regarding risk.
Further information, or support in your application, please direct this to the RFU Head of Safeguarding - VivienRimmer@RFU.com

# Regional Fundraising Manager
United Kingdom
## Job Description
Working at the RFU means being part of the ‘bigger picture’ at England Rugby: to be rooted in our purpose, which is to enrich lives, introduce more people to rugby union & develop the sport for future generations. If our purpose resonates with you, and you recognise the value that sport can bring to people’s lives, we’d love to work with you. An opportunity has arisen for four Regional Fundraising Managers to join our Rugby Development team on a 3yr FTC basis.
**Job Title : Regional Fundraising Manager** Department : Rugby Development Reports to : Regional Partnerships Manager Direct report(s) : None Salary : c.£45,000-£47,000 per annum Job Level : Implement Location : Homebased, covering a region (North, Midlands West, South Central, South East) Travel Requirements : Regular travel within region, and occasional travel to Allianz stadium, as required Employment Type : 3-year Fixed Term Contract Working Hours : This is a full-time role, covering 35hrs per week on any five out of the seven days of the week (from Monday to Sunday inclusive)
**Application Information:**
* Please submit an anonymised CV (i.e. remove personal details). You do not need to submit a cover letter.
* Vacancy closing date: ***7th August at 12:00 noon***
***To help us get to know your unique experience and voice, we kindly ask that you complete your application without the use of AI‐generated content. This ensures we can fairly and accurately understand your skills, perspective, and suitability for the role.***
**The Role:**
The RFU has recently launched Plan 2030: ‘More Than A Game’, which is our strategy to grow rugby across England for the next five years.
Our strategy contains four big goals that support and connect to one another - Play, Perform, Follow and Fund. In ‘Play’ we’re aiming to have an additional 50,000 registered players and have more people playing rugby for longer.
One of the ways we are planning to unlock this growth is through a transformation in how the RFU delivers community rugby by creating seven Regional Growth Partnership Boards tasked with driving participation, building partnerships, and unlocking funding opportunities within their region.
The RFU has launched a new plan focused on the growth of Community Rugby in England. The goal is simple: introduce more people to rugby, and help them keep playing for longer.
To support this, the RFU is creating seven new Regional Growth Partnership Boards. Each board will focus on promoting and growing rugby in its area. Their main responsibilities are to:
* Create new opportunities for people to play rugby in more places
* Build strong regional relationships that help the sport
* Manage RFU funding for local growth projects
* Bring in additional external income to support more opportunities
Each region will have a Regional Fundraising Manager who will lead fundraising and revenue‐generating activity to support these growth plans.
**What the role will do:**
* Lead fundraising across multiple income streams (e.g., public sector grants, trusts, foundations, philanthropy, events, and ESG/commercial funding)
* Work closely with the Regional Partnerships Manager and Regional Board to support the development and delivery of the regional growth plan
* Identify local opportunities and challenges and turn them into successful funding proposals
**Impact / Outcomes:**
* Brings in new external income that directly enables new rugby activity and programmes
* Ensures the region can fund innovative projects that increase participation
* Builds long‐term funding relationships that strengthen community rugby
**The Team:**
Each region will have a small team made up of a Regional Partnerships Manager and a Fundraising Manager, supported by central staff including a Head of Regional Partnerships, a National Fundraising Manager, and Data and Insights Manager.
This team will work closely with a Regional Board made up of independent members, RFU representatives, and people from the community game. Together, they will create and deliver a plan to help more people in the region experience Rugby Union. This is a new team, so you will have the chance to help shape how it works and contribute to building something from the ground up.
Although this role is home‐based, you will spend some time travelling around the region to secure funding opportunities.
**Some key responsibilities include:**
* Work closely with the Regional Partnerships Manager and Regional Board to help develop and deliver the Regional Rugby Promotion & Growth Plan.
* Create and deliver the region’s external funding strategy, securing income from public, private, and charitable sources.
* Lead all fundraising activity, including writing funding applications, running events, and developing early‐stage prospects.
* Bring new, creative ideas to identify and pursue additional fundraising opportunities.
* Track, manage, and report all funding information, from identifying prospects through to receiving and spending funds.
* Build strong relationships and collaborate with colleagues across regions and departments to share learning and best practice.
* Acting as an ambassador for, and promoting the best interests of the RFU, including the promotion of our culture and core values – This Rose Means Everyone: Put The Team First, Shape The Future, Respect Each Other.
* Undertaking other duties as may be required from time to time as are consistent with the responsibilities of the post and the needs of the organisation.
**Qualifications, Skills & Experience:**
*The skills and attributes outlined in this description are not exhaustive and we welcome candidates who can bring different relevant experiences to the role.*
***Essential:***
* Proven experience running successful fundraising programmes across public and private sectors.
* Track record of meeting income targets and KPIs.
* Experience planning and delivering fundraising events.
* Good understanding of how charities work.
* Strong knowledge of best‐practice fundraising at local and regional levels.
* Experience producing accurate financial reports for fundraising activity.
* Experience delivering projects with a range of internal and external partners.
* Confident working with stakeholders at all levels.
* Strong communication and relationship‐building skills, both written and verbal.
* Excellent organisation and time‐management skills, with the ability to handle multiple projects at once.
* Able to work independently and take initiative.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Creative problem‐solver with a positive, proactive attitude.
* Confident using Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

**Principal Consultant – Onshore Post-Consent Compliance Manager / Consents Manager**
**Make Your Mark at ERM**
ERM is seeking an experienced and motivated Principal Consultant – Onshore Consents Manager to lead the delivery of post-consent environmental compliance services across major infrastructure projects. This role offers the opportunity to support projects through the critical transition from consent to construction, ensuring compliance with consent requirements, environmental commitments, and regulatory obligations.
Working across sectors including electricity transmission and distribution, renewable energy, hydrogen, solar, and onshore wind, you will play a leading role in helping clients successfully implement consented projects while managing environmental risk and maintaining strong relationships with regulators and stakeholders.
As a senior member of the team, you will provide strategic advice, oversee compliance delivery, manage multidisciplinary project teams, and support the continued growth of ERM’s post-consent services.
**The Role**
As a Consents Manager, you will lead environmental compliance and consent management activities throughout the post-consent phase of major projects. You will act as a trusted advisor to clients, ensuring that consent requirements, planning conditions, commitments, and legal obligations are effectively managed and discharged.
**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and deliver Environmental Consents Manager and Post-Consent Compliance Manager roles on major infrastructure projects from consent through construction.
* Develop and implement consent management and compliance strategies to support project delivery and reduce environmental and regulatory risk.
* Establish and maintain comprehensive consents, commitments, and obligations registers, ensuring requirements are clearly tracked and managed.
* Provide oversight of consent compliance processes and ensure project teams understand and fulfil environmental commitments.
* Coordinate the preparation and submission of applications for the discharge of requirements, planning conditions, and other consent-related obligations.
* Act as the primary point of contact for consent and compliance queries from project teams, clients, contractors, regulators, and other stakeholders.
* Liaise with regulatory bodies, including the Planning Inspectorate, Local Planning Authorities, Environment Agency, Natural England, and other statutory consultees.
* Support and lead environmental compliance audits, inspections, and regulatory reviews.
* Prepare clear and concise reports on compliance status, emerging risks, and consent-related matters for clients, regulators, and senior project leadership.
* Collaborate closely with engineering, environmental, planning, legal, and construction teams to ensure effective integration of consent requirements into project delivery.
* Support business development through proposal preparation, client engagement, presentations, and thought leadership initiatives.
* Mentor and develop junior team members, contributing to a positive and collaborative team culture.
**Why This Role Matters**
The successful delivery of major infrastructure projects depends on effective environmental compliance and robust consent management. As a Principal Consultant, you will help clients navigate complex regulatory frameworks, maintain compliance throughout construction, and deliver projects responsibly and sustainably.
Your expertise will play a critical role in managing environmental risk, protecting project programmes, and ensuring projects achieve their objectives while meeting regulatory expectations and environmental commitments.
**What We're Looking For**
*Essential*
* Experience in environmental consent management, post-consent compliance, or environmental project delivery within the UK infrastructure sector.
* Degree (or equivalent qualification) in Environmental Management, Environmental Planning, Geography, Ecology, Engineering, Law, or a related discipline.
* Proven experience supporting or leading the discharge of consent requirements, planning conditions, and environmental commitments on major infrastructure projects.
* Strong understanding of UK planning and consenting regimes, including:
+ Development Consent Orders (DCOs)
+ Town and Country Planning Act
+ Electricity Act Section 36 Consents
+ Associated environmental permitting and licensing requirements
* Knowledge of Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA), environmental legislation, and the practical implementation of mitigation and monitoring commitments during construction.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with experience engaging clients, regulators, contractors, and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Strong organisational and analytical skills, including management of complex compliance, legal, and regulatory requirements.
* Experience preparing compliance reports, consent submissions, and regulatory correspondence.
* Excellent communication, project management, and problem-solving skills.
*Desirable*
* Experience managing environmental compliance during construction phases of major infrastructure projects.
* Experience working within sectors such as transmission and distribution, renewable energy, hydrogen, solar, or wind.
* Professional membership of a relevant institution (IEMA, RTPI, CIWEM, CEnv or equivalent).
* Line management or mentoring experience.
**What You'll Bring**
You are a proactive and client-focused environmental professional with a strong understanding of post-consent project delivery. You combine technical knowledge with commercial awareness and are confident working with clients, regulators, and project teams to deliver successful outcomes. You thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy solving complex challenges, and are passionate about helping infrastructure projects achieve high environmental standards.

As a Construction Environmental Manager, you will lead environmental compliance and environmental management activities during construction. You will act as the primary environmental point of contact on-site, ensuring environmental requirements are effectively implemented, monitored, and communicated across all project activities.
You will work closely with project teams to identify environmental risks, resolve compliance issues, and ensure mitigation measures and monitoring commitments are delivered effectively throughout construction.

Effective environmental management during construction is essential to delivering infrastructure projects safely, responsibly, and in compliance with regulatory requirements. As a Construction Environmental Manager, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring environmental commitments made during the consenting process are successfully implemented on the ground.
Your expertise will help clients reduce environmental risk, maintain programme certainty, foster positive stakeholder relationships, and demonstrate environmental leadership throughout construction. Through your work, you will contribute to the successful delivery of projects that support the transition to a more sustainable future.
**What We're Looking For**

* Experience in construction environmental management, environmental compliance, environmental advisory, or project environmental delivery within the UK infrastructure sector.
* Degree (or equivalent qualification) in Environmental Management, Environmental Science, Geography, Ecology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Experience supporting or leading environmental management activities during the construction phase of major infrastructure projects.
* Strong understanding of environmental legislation, regulatory compliance requirements, and environmental management systems.
* Experience implementing and monitoring Construction Environmental Management Plans (CEMPs) and associated environmental controls.
* Knowledge of Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) commitments and the practical implementation of mitigation and monitoring measures during construction.
* Experience undertaking environmental audits, inspections, compliance assessments, and incident investigations.
* Strong understanding of environmental topics including pollution prevention, ecology, biodiversity, water quality, waste management, noise, air quality, and protected species management.
* Experience working collaboratively with contractors, construction managers, engineers, project managers, and environmental specialists.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic construction environment.
* Full UK driving licence and willingness to travel and work on project sites as required.
*Desirable*
* Experience working on transmission and distribution, renewable energy, hydrogen, or other major infrastructure projects.
* Professional membership of a relevant institution (IEMA, CIWEM, CIEEM, CEnv or equivalent).
* Internal or Lead Auditor qualification.
* Knowledge of ISO 14001 Environmental Management Systems.
* Experience supporting regulatory inspections and engagement with organisations such as the Environment Agency, Natural England, NatureScot, Natural Resources Wales, or local authorities.
* Line management, mentoring, or supervisory experience.
* Experience working within principal contractor or EPC contractor environments.

You are a proactive, solutions-focused environmental professional who thrives in a construction environment. You enjoy being on-site, working directly with project teams to solve challenges, manage environmental risks, and ensure compliance requirements are translated into practical actions.
You bring strong technical knowledge, sound judgement, and the confidence to engage with construction personnel, clients, and regulators. # Social Media & Video Officer, FT FLIC
London
**Social Media & Video Officer**
**Salary:** £30,000
**Hours:** Full-time
**Location:** Hybrid working, based in the FT offices in St Paul’s. The role requires a minimum of two office days per week, currently Monday and Wednesday.
**The organisation**
The FT Financial Literacy and Inclusion Campaign (FT FLIC), the fast-expanding financial literacy charity founded by the Financial Times, promotes financial literacy where it is needed most to have a significant, sustainable societal impact.
The charity works with young people in schools, adult learners, community groups and workers across the UK. We also support policy and advocacy work, with the mission of giving everyone the tools to build lifelong money confidence.
**About FT FLIC’s programmes**
FT FLIC has developed an award-winning financial literacy curriculum for secondary schools and is now working with national partners to build a comprehensive catalogue of digital resources for adult learners.
With input from FT journalists, production specialists, educators and beneficiaries, we create a range of engaging educational materials. These include visual, audio and text-based resources for use across our programmes and digital learning platforms.
Our content includes educational videos, lesson materials, guides, worksheets and supporting resources designed to equip learners with essential financial literacy skills, helping them manage everyday finances and pursue their financial goals.
**The role**
We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Social Media and Video Officer to support the production, editing and distribution of engaging financial education content across digital platforms. This role is perfect for someone eager to develop their skills in video production, social media management and content strategy, working within a dynamic creative team.
You will assist in scripting, filming, editing, and distributing both short-form and long-form video content, ensuring it is optimised for different social platforms. Working closely with the Video and Social Media Manager, you will help bring financial literacy content to life in a way that is clear, engaging, and accessible.
You will also support the optimisation of content across platforms, monitor performance, and contribute ideas to improve engagement. A strong awareness of social media trends and audience behaviour will be key to ensuring our content resonates with the right audiences.
This role is crucial in our mission to provide clear, up-to-date, and accessible financial education resources, helping people navigate the financial world, avoid common pitfalls, and maximise opportunities. You will have a strong understanding of social media trends and audience engagement strategies, ensuring our content is both informative and compelling.
You will be comfortable working independently while collaborating with a wider team in a fast-paced, creative environment. There will also be opportunities to contribute to new content formats, support live video sessions, and attend industry events.
Beyond reaching beneficiaries, this role will also support the creation of content that communicates FT FLIC’s impact to a broader range of stakeholders, including funders, corporate partners, policymakers, and educators. You will contribute content for key campaigns, partner activity, and platforms such as LinkedIn, adapting tone and format for different audiences while maintaining brand consistency.
This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career video and social media professional to gain hands-on experience while contributing to a mission-driven organisation.
**Key Responsibilities**
* Schedule and publish content across various social media platforms.
* Assist in the production, editing, and post-production of video content for digital platforms.
* Support the creation of short-form and long-form video content tailored for social media (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, etc.).
* Conduct due diligence on content creators we may partner with.
* Edit and enhance video footage using Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects.
* Design engaging social media, promotional, and distribution assets (e.g. newsletters, event materials, advertising graphics) using tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or Figma
* Ensure all visual content adheres to design accessibility best practices (e.g. readability, contrast, captions, inclusive design).
* Help manage and organise video assets to ensure proper storage and accessibility.
* Monitor social media trends, engagement metrics, and audience interactions to optimise content performance (including A/B testing).
* Actively engage in financial literacy conversations on social media by reposting, commenting, and interacting with the community.
* Collaborate with the wider marketing and creative teams to ensure brand consistency across content.
* Support the creation of content for fundraising campaigns (including the annual seasonal appeal), ensuring content is engaging and optimised for different audiences
* Create content that communicates programme impact to stakeholders such as funders, partners, and educators, including campaign highlights and outcomes
* Support partner-facing and LinkedIn content, adapting tone and format for professional, policy, and education audiences
* Assist with other content creation and distribution tasks as needed.
* Monitor, collect and analyse data for impact reporting
**Requirements**
* Basic maths skills & ability to understand financial topics
* Basic proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Photoshop).
* Understanding of video production processes, including filming, editing, and post-production.
* Familiarity with social media platforms and strategies for engagement and content performance tracking.
* Strong visual and design sensibilities with attention to detail.
* Awareness of design accessibility principles and best practices for digital content.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, creative environment.
* Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
* Some experience in content creation, video editing, or social media management is a plus.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Previous experience in video production or social media content creation.
* Knowledge of animation or motion graphics.
* Ability to apply design tools such as Figma or Adobe Creative Suite to produce high-quality, brand consistent assets across Flic’s digital platforms.
* Experience with social media analytics and A/B testing.
* A passion for storytelling through visual media.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a budding video and social media professional to grow their skills, gain real-world experience, and contribute to a brand making a difference in financial education.
